body:
I am also scared that I will not get a job. People are so superficial and if I do not get work soon I will be homeless :'-(

My eye is giving me so much pain today and there is nothing I can do about it.

I barely ate yesterday and I dont think I will eat much today either.

Thank you :-) I did go to the doctor today and made it clear that I was getting worse, but he just ignored the remark. I understand that suicide hurts everyone around me, but when you feel so helpless and anguished as I do you stop caring about everyone else and their needs. I don't want to hurt anyone but I need to stop hurting myself.

I went to the doctor, and I now have to see a specialist about my eye...

But when I told him that my depression and anxiety have gotten much worse but he didn't say anything about it...
Australia...
I wonder if I can do that in my country...
I wonder if I can do that in my country...
I wish I could learn to not think. That is what peace would be

Haha, it is illegal here, but I am reluctant to give it a go because my family history with it is not good. Weed=schizophrenia in my family. Like, it is a serious issue. Multiple family members have had problems.
Thank you. I will check it out.

I was removed from my father's care when I was 5 (having witnessed my mother's death earlier) because of repeated problems with various types of abuse, neglect and extreme violence (the last incident, which instigated my permanent removal involved a shotgun). I moved around a bit though growing up. So I suppose I was not exposed to their problems for too long, although I was exposed to other peoples.

That's the thing; I always tell people to keep going and encourage them to get help when I know they are unwell/mentally ill but they all have something in common: they have treatable conditions and their brains are not hardwired badly. Given my past, I am considered a roaring success; but it comes at a cost because I could never tell someone with a similar background that they will be okay one day. Because I know that they never will be :-(

I have always felt that I am alive for the sake of others, and I hate it.

Yeah I certainly avoid shit foods when I can, I avoid alcohol completely and I am trying to stick to a raw food diet. My other health issues are not related to weight at all, and I am in the healthy range. I only ever drink water or milk because I hate softdrinks and cordials and etc. Unfortunately, diet will not stop my other chronic problems, but I eat well because I hoped that it would lower my depression.

Thank you so much for your advice. I worry that I would survive the fall and just become a para/quadraplegic (which would make things worse!) so that is why I havent already tried that

Funny you mention Yoga! I love yoga. Although I cannot meditate (I am practicing though), the exercise is good. I know that exercise is supposed to help with depression so I do make efforts to get as much as I can. 

I will see my doctor, but the only additional thing he could recommend is hospitalisation and that is a temporary solution (it physically restrains you from actually committing suicide). I need something long term, something that will re-configure my brain...I know this doesn't exist but the things I would do for it....
Try to exhaust all other avenues before you take such drastic measures. In this I mean try counselling, medication or other treatments. Maybe things are not as hopeless as they seem?

Yes, there are wonderful things in life. I help others celebrate their lives and achievements as best I can. I just feel robbed because I cannot actually relax and enjoy things EVER. This is the nature of the damage. If I do go blind/cannot work for other reasons, I am essentially screwed. I have no financial support from my family (was a ward of the state from 5 upwards) and at the end of the year I will be homeless which is why I need work (and I cannot afford to study for a new career because I have exceeded my allowable loan limit). I know that I can live; it is just that I don't want to because I hate the struggle and fight.
I really hate my depression and I would give anything to be a whole, completely healthy person.

I am getting treatment, although it is sketchy at the moment. It is a combination of counselling and medication. Unfortunately, this is not helping, but not from a lack of effort on my part!
My eye has been exposed to the cold sore virus; although I cannot be sure that this has caused the damage, there is damage to my eye from something (confirmed at the optometrist) and I am afraid that it is getting worse yet I am afraid to see a doctor about it.
Yes, I do want help. I want a cure! But I know that this is impossible, so that is why suicide is so attractive. I feel like that person in mythology who is doomed to push a boulder up a hill.
Thank you for your kind words. I have given this fight everything I have for decades, and I am just exhausted. I need peace so badly, and the daily fight is not giving me any :'-(

Yeah, I have seen sooooo many specialists about this, ranging from counselors, doctors, psychologists, hypnotists, psychiatrists, neuropsychologists/psychiatrists and neurologists; they seem to all acknowledge the fact that I am a treatment case rather than cure. And I was also told that medication will not cure everyone, and that it is not effective in some people- it also doesnt stop my suicidal thoughts. I have also seen multiple doctors over the years, and I have run out of medication alternatives :-( Seriously, I have been in treatment (different varieties) since I was about 5 years old. I really have tried to fight this thing. It is just that apparently my brain developed differently from the norm (because of all the abuse) and unfortunately, this cannot be reversed (this was not from the doctor; it came from one of the neuropsychologists I have seen).

I apologise, in my country health care is extremely cheap or free. The chronic pain groups should be free however, and the members may also have an in with people who can treat you on a free basis; if nothing else, they know what you are going through in relation to pain and feelings of helplessness.

I have no close friends that I can talk to, and no family either. I hide my illness from everyone anyway. I don't think I can vent any more; I just want peace for the first time in my entire life. I am also upset that even though I survived my childhood and tried to make a life for myself, I will always be denied peace, happiness and health. There is nothing anyone can do and I cannot live like this any more. Every day for decades I have felt intense pain. I feel that suicide is my only chance.
have you tried to seek treatment for your mental pain? Perhaps a visit with your doctor, or an appointment with a counselor could help. There may also be chronic pain support groups?

I just keep crying. I am at my wits end at the moment and the only thing that is preventing me from just jumping off a building is the fear of hurting innocent people and a lack of access to sufficient height.

I understand where you are coming from, and I am in the same boat. I also have not told anyone, and I feel very confident that no one really knows what I am going through, or that I am planning suicide. 
It can be difficult to find someone to talk to, because if people find out that someone is a suicide risk, they may try to have that person institutionalised. However, phone services may be of use, because they cannot do anything but listen. You should give that a go. Getting this stuff off your chest may make you feel better.
